name: Jinsei Game to Shitai no Kanojo
original_name: 人生ゲームと死体の彼女
source:
There was a God who created the world to be in one place.

God left the world he created to humanity, but one day when he looked into the human world, he noticed a girl. The girl jumped off her school rooftop to kill herself.

God was very shocked by the behavior of the girl who just happened to catch his eye.

"Is the world I created so uncomfortable?"

God, who does not want to admit that the world he created was flawed, decided to rewind time and try to change the girl's fate. However, the girl died again and again.

Yet still, God rewinds time -- over and over again.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21276]Freem![/url]]
translation:
某处，有一位创造世界的神。

神将自己创造的世界交给人类。某天，他俯瞰人间时，注意到一个女孩。女孩从学校的天台跳下，结束了自己的生命。

这个偶然映入眼帘的女孩，她的举动令神大为震惊。

“我创造的世界，就这么让人难以忍受吗？”

不愿承认自己的世界存在缺陷的神，决定让时间倒流，试着改变女孩的命运。然而，女孩仍一次又一次地死去。

即便如此，神依旧让时间倒流——一遍，又一遍。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21276]Freem![/url]]
